_help: SSS Pro coverage tracker for official partner pages (ANZ). The daily 'SSS partner data' task works down this list: never-checked first (lowest tier first), then the oldest lastChecked. name = the property exactly as written in deals.json. partnersUrl = the official partners page found. lastChecked = YYYY-MM-DD. onPage = partners readable on that page at the last check. Add a property here to get it covered. On every check, record each partner's grouping exactly as the page labels it in that deal's "ptier" (singular, sentence case, e.g. "Platinum partner"), its official title in "ptitle" when the page shows one (e.g. "Official Airline Partner"), and the page's groupings top-down in that property's "ptiers" in entities.json with "ptiersChecked" set to the check date. Pages with no groupings: leave ptier off. Never invent a tier. Then run tools/ptiers.py and tools/build_profiles.py.
